milestone: Initial Vapor Firefox appearance, 0.1.0; Breeze-inspired UI is part of the default complete setup.
private_window_behavior: Vapor tab strip, selected tab, toolbar, address field, 3px control shapes, private start-page background and shadow search field; native private badges/messages retained.

firefox_home.detail: Stock Firefox Home React root remains empty without any custom stylesheet enabled.

test_methods.browser: Firefox 159 headless, isolated profiles and test-owned processes; actual UI snapshots and painted pixels.
test_methods.states: Real field focus; synthetic InspectorUtils hover/active locks on test-owned toolbar buttons.
test_methods.private: PrivateBrowsingUtils and privatebrowsingmode state plus visible private indicators.
test_methods.automation_cue: Remove only the remotecontrol attribute from stock and themed test windows before capture.
test_methods.focus_transitions: Await finite native CSS animations and completed frames.
test_methods.gui: Extracted-bundle launcher exercised with a simulated kdialog chooser; no real user profile selected.

initial_findings_and_corrections: Private welcome/search content is outside the ordinary theme API; the user required Breeze UI by default, so the default complete setup uses owned browser/page CSS and a setup tool.
Firefox 159 private search uses a shadow component; set its documented host variables directly to remove its purple fill and use 3px corners.
Wait for native focus transitions before sampling; toolbar pixels use a clear gutter away from the classic address-field shadow.
Measure the button badge-stack surface rather than its nested glyph when checking shape/fill.
The independently tested stock Firefox Home React root remains empty without any custom styles; Home widget rendering remains blocked and is not counted as tested.
Setup rollback removes newly created empty directories; injected failures at all six write positions leave the profile retryable and preserve its prior files.
not_validated: Forced colors/high contrast and full keyboard/screen-reader/RTL coverage
